ABOUT

Nai Yidan is a designer and maker working across interactive systems, wearable technology and digital fabrication.

Her practice moves between care-focused products and critical narratives, translating complex social questions into experiences people can see, hear and feel.

She works with Arduino, sensors, sound, light, 3D printing and ergonomic prototyping, and is currently based in London.
